€1, 4 P. (हर्षति, हृष्यति, हृष्ट or हृषित) 
__1 To be delighted or rejoiced, be pleased or glad, to exult, rejoice; अद्वितीयं रुचात्मानं मत्वा किं चन्द्र हृष्यसि [[Bv. 2. 54]]; [[Mv. 7. 13.]] 
__2 To bristle or stand erect, stand on end (as the hair of the body); सुखवेदनाहृषितरोमकूपया [[Śi. 13. 13]]; हृषितास्तनूरुहाः [[Dk.]]; हृष्यन्ति रोमकूपानि [[Mb.]] 
__3 To become erect (said of other things, e. g. the penis). 
__4 To lie, tell a lie. -Caus. (हर्षयति-ते) To please, delight, fill with pleasure.

m., f. 
__1 Joy, satisfaction. 
__2 Splendour. 
__3 A liar.

p. p. [हृष्-क्त वा° इट्] 
__1 Pleased, delighted, glad, happy, rejoiced, enraptured. 
__2 Thrilled; having the hair bristling. 
__3 Astonished. 
__4 Bent, bowed. 
__5 Disappointed. 
__6 Fresh. 
__7 Armed, accoutred. 
__8 Dulled, blunted.

[हृष्-ई कक् [[Uṇ. 4. 26]]] An organ of sense; न मे हृषीकाणि पतन्त्यसत्पथे [[Bhāg. 2. 6. 33.]] 
-Comp. 
-ईशः an epithet of Viṣṇu; or Kṛṣṇa; पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देबदत्तं धनंजयः (दध्मौ) [[Bg. 1. 15]]; et. seq. (हृषीकाणीन्द्रियाण्याहुस्तेषामीशो यतो भवान् । हृषीकेशस्ततो विष्णो ख्यातो देवेषु केशव ॥ [[Mb.]])

a. 
__1 Pleased, rejoiced. 
__2 Telling lies. 
-षुः 
__1 Fire. 
__2 The sun. 
__3 The moon.

p. p. [हृष्-क्त] 
__1 Pleased, rejoiced (= हृषित). 
__2 Bristling, erect, standing on end. 
__3 Rigid, stiff. 
__4 Blunted. 
__5 Surprised. 
-Comp. 
-चित्त, -मानस a. rejoiced in mind, glad at heart, happy. 
-तनु, -तनूरुह, -रोमन् a. having the hair on the body bristling or thrilling (with joy). 
-रूप a. in a happy mood. 
-वदन a. having a cheerful countenance. 
-संकल्प a. contented, pleased. 
-हृदय a. joyous-hearted, cheerful, merry.

f. [हृष्-क्तिन्] 
__1 Delight, happiness, joy, pleasure; वस्ताण्डवं देवि भूयादभीष्टपै च हृष्टपै च नः [[Māl. 5. 23.]] 
__2 Pride. 
__3 Knowledge. 
-Comp. 
-योनिः a kind of semi-impotent man.
